_about:
Topic diagrams shown when a recognized sign or corrected fingerspelled word matches a keyword. Each 'mermaid' entry is a list of lines of Mermaid flowchart source, one node or arrow per line, so the text is easy to edit. Text goes inside the quotes;
starts a new line inside a box. Keep the content accurate.

topics.title: Sensor calibration
mermaid:
S1["1. Warm up
Power on and wait until readings are steady (about 10 minutes)"]

S2["2. Zero
Read with nothing applied; record the offset"]

S3["3. Apply known values
Reference weights at 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% of the range"]

S4["4. Record
The sensor's reading next to each known value"]

S5["5. Fit
true value = gain × reading + offset"]
OK["Label the sensor with the date and log the result"]

FIX["Find the cause
(loose mount, wrong weight, drift)"]

topics.title: Torque: tightening bolts
mermaid:
T["Torque τ = r × F
lever arm × force, in N·m"]

A["Set the torque wrench to spec
(for example 25 N·m)"]

topics.title: Velocity
mermaid:
D["Displacement
how far, in a direction (m)"] --> V["Velocity = displacement ÷ time"]

V --> R["Has a direction
e.g. 3 m/s → east"]
